_comment: features/api/risk_management/risk_metric_retrieval.feature. The metric type Outline is 002 to 006 (DELTA, GAMMA, VEGA, THETA, PNL), the unsupported metric type 007. Its steps take the metric type from the Examples, so its rows have no request, as in the old YAML (only a responseRef to RESP-TPL-RISK-METRIC-RETRIEVAL-API-003, now in each expected file). The rules keep the old placeholders.

cases._comment: All risk metrics are returned for a live trade in a single bulk request
Supported metric type DELTA is accepted and returns correct value
Supported metric type GAMMA is accepted and returns correct value
Supported metric type VEGA is accepted and returns correct value
Supported metric type THETA is accepted and returns correct value

Per-metric request is rejected when an unsupported metric type is provided
